# Topic title

- Entry ID: category/topic-name
- Researched: YYYY-MM-DD
- Status: researched / implemented / verified / superseded / blocked
- Question: the concrete problem and affected workflow
- Scope: feature, layer, language/framework/database versions

## Evidence

List exact source URLs, files/methods and release/commit. Record maintainer/author, date, licence when reusing code, a short excerpt where useful and what it demonstrates. Identify inaccessible/rejected sources and material compatibility limits. Follow quotation limits; link longer source instead of copying it.

## CEREMO decision and reuse

Distinguish observed reference behaviour from our chosen policy. Name existing shared/feature types, dependency direction and adaptations. Explain what the source does not establish.

## Local implementation

Link relevant source, tests and existing product/architecture documents. Say which parts exist and which are proposals. Cross-link related research entries.

## Verification and remaining work

Record actual command, date, target environment, result and unverified behaviour. Never copy secrets from tool output. Update status after verification; preserve superseded decisions with a replacement link.
